title: Serre vanishing for restricted projective-space twists over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], N a natural number, and i:X→P^N_A a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let F be a quasi-coherent module of finite presentation on X [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine]. There exists a natural number t0 such that H^p(X,F tensor i^*O(t)) is zero for every p>0 and t>=t0, with module cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology], tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and the projective-space twists [def-pc-projective-space-twist].

source.place: Tags 01YS (2),(4) and 0B5T, preliminary closed-immersion comparison and proof of (4); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YS and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B5T read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Projective space over the Noetherian ring A is locally Noetherian, as is its closed subscheme X. Finite presentation implies finite type; together with quasi-coherence this makes F coherent. Pushforward along the closed immersion gives a coherent module G=i_*F on projective space.

Use projective-space Serre vanishing: a finite sum of twists surjects onto G, with coherent kernel. The N+1 standard affine opens give zero cohomology above N. Descending induction in the degree, for all coherent modules at once, combines exactness of twisting, vanishing of nonnegative twists over any base ring, and the long exact sequence to give bounds for each positive degree. Take their finite maximum and zero. The node lem-pc-projective-space-serre-vanishing states this ring-general theorem, but its recorded Lean declaration only covers fields and abelian-sheaf H; that missing generalization is part of the hole here.

The projection formula identifies i_*(F tensor i^*O(t)) with G tensor O(t). For the affine closed immersion, affine_morphism_cohomology_edge is an isomorphism in every degree. Thus vanishing of the latter module cohomology gives vanishing on X, with the same uniform natural-number bound.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_moduleCohomology_tensor_twist_of_closedImmersion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {N : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ (p t : ℕ), 0 < p → t₀ ≤ t →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj
        (tensorObj F (ProjectiveSpace.twistRestrict i t)))
